newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Big C mandates US$120 mln term loan.
newsitem.headline: Big C mandates US$120 mln term loan.

text.p: Big C Supercenter Public Co Ltd has mandated two banks to arrange a US$120 million term loan facility, a syndicate manager said.
The arrangers are AFC Merchant Bank and Overseas Union Bank.
An underwriting group is being formed, the sources said.
Big C was established last June following the merger of superstore outlets belonging to Thailand's two leading department stores, the Central Group and Robinson Department Store Co Ltd.
Preecha Ekkunagul, managing director of Big C Supercenter, told Reuters in an interview last November that his company planned to build more outlets in 1997.
